what_this_is: V7, a calibrated discrimination tier selected by measurement over a real Flash population, plus the Phase 1-3 analysis that produced it.
task: the same datapipe repair task as V1-V4; V7 scores its live behaviour core
task_book: bench/v7/ONBOARDING_TODO.md = v2.3 book + two published spec fixes

v7_anchors.note: anchors show the tier is anchored, NOT that it is hard (brief section 23)

key_findings: the legacy suite still discriminates on the current population (19.3-pt spread) while V5 v2.4.1 does not (1.4-pt)
the legacy 81 tests map to only 24 semantic behaviours; correlation(n_tests, fail_rate) = 0.130, so the old raw score did NOT amplify hard behaviours
the 7-item floor cluster was specification gaps, not difficulty: publishing the rules moved three of them from p=0.06 to p=1.00
after removing those, only 3 of 10 V7 behaviours are live -- genuine contract-derivable discrimination among current Flash models is thin
v7_status: NOT FROZEN -- 2 strong families tie at 0.667, within-model variance still high
